text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Displeased by Operation Oversight, Taiki Shuttle and some other students go to talk to Ms. Kashimoto in person.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ms. Kashimoto offers a wager—she will reinstate the Unity Cup, but if her own team wins, then the students must accept her management system.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The team she gathers is led by Bitter Glasse and Little Cocon and consists of elite racers who agree with her methods.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I rush about finding members for my team. The fate of Tracen Academy is at stake!
